Indexes incorporating the current business day's filings are updated nightly starting about 10:00 p.m., ET; the process is usually completed within a few hours. verdict: Sampled discrepancies do not support blindly advancing pair times. Bulk is 4/5 hours late relative to ET-header-derived UTC in 14 sampled disagreements; one agreeing pair/bulk case is also 5 hours late. The raw source strings carry Z yet do not uniformly encode the same acceptance instant. Full authoritative scope/normalization cannot be inferred from column equality or a universal offset.
